origin.title: 2026년도 3분기 실적발표 (3Q 2026 Earnings Presentation)
origin.clearance_note: Investor relations material published by a listed company (KRX: 035420) on its own domain for general distribution. Downloaded by script directly from the publisher's download endpoint, which served application/pdf with the filename 3Q26_Naver_Earnings_KOR_vF.pdf; renamed here. Contains no personal data: no individual is named anywhere in the deck.

notes: No feature page or fields were requested; chosen here. Page 3 (실적요약, results summary) features the quarter's headline story: revenue up 10.7% YoY to 3,472.4 billion KRW while operating profit fell 20.9% to 451.3 billion, with net income of 402.5 billion. That is the same story the slide's two bullets tell. Every value grounds to its own table cell in the 3Q26 and Y/Y columns. Occurrence 0 is pinned for the YoY changes because the same figures are repeated on page 7 (costs) and, for revenue, the footnote's ex-acquisition sentence also grounds (OFF, it says 9.0%, not 10.7%).
